setup.title: Welcome to Slouchcat
setup.intro: Four short steps, then Slouchcat scans your first library.

account.title: Administrator account
account.description: You manage Slouchcat with this account.

library.title: First library
library.description: You can add more libraries later.
library.name: Name

network_share.title: Network share detected
network_share.body: Slouchcat does not see changes in this folder at once but through a regular sync. For new titles to appear without delay, webhooks from Radarr and Sonarr are recommended.

fuse_unknown.title: Unknown file system
fuse_unknown.body: A FUSE file system (for example mergerfs or Unraid) does not report every change. Slouchcat watches the folder and also syncs it regularly.

tmdb.title: Metadata from TMDB (optional)
tmdb.description: With a read access token from themoviedb.org Slouchcat fetches overviews, posters and age ratings. Without a key, titles come from the file names.
tmdb.label: API read access token
tmdb.hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

result.invalid: Invalid: TMDB rejected the key. Check the read access token.
result.unreachable: Unreachable: TMDB does not answer right now. Try again or leave the field empty.

system.title: Graphics chip and file system
system.description: What Slouchcat finds inside the container. There is nothing to enter here; the hints are for the host.
system.missing: The server sent no details about the hardware.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in with your Slouchcat account.

library.defaultRatingHint: Applies to every title of this library. Single titles can only be rated stricter afterwards.
library.podcastsHint: Folder optional: you can also subscribe to feeds without a folder under Podcasts.

browse.title: Choose a folder
browse.emptyRoots: No folder is released. Set {{name}} to the media folders of the container and restart the server.
browse.truncated: This folder holds a great many entries. The first 50,000 are shown; type the path to reach the rest.
browse.notReadable: This folder cannot be read. Check the permissions inside the container.
browse.notUnderRoot: This path lies below none of the browsable folders, so the list stays where it is. “OK” hands it on anyway; the server decides about it when the form is submitted. {{name}} sets which folders are browsable.

content.title: Content
content.hint: Films as single files, series in season folders.

providers.title: Metadata sources
providers.hint: The first entry identifies the title, the others only fill in. Reorder with the arrows or the arrow keys.
providers.hintRank: The first entry identifies the title, the others only fill in. Choose the order with the position.
providers.cannotIdentify: {{provider}} cannot identify a title. Put {{identifiers}} first.
providers.fixedHint: This content has only this source today.
providers.defaultHint: The default; the list can be changed under Libraries after the setup.

roots.title: Folders
roots.emptyPodcasts: No folder yet. A podcast library may stay without folders; its titles then come from the feed subscriptions.

library.videoHint: The folders of this library may hold films or series, mixed as well.

notFound.title: Library not found
notFound.body: This library does not exist or has no titles for this profile.

empty.title: Nothing here yet

rank.label: Position of {{name}}
rank.hintSwap: The entry in the chosen position swaps with this one.

rankedChoice.hint: Picking an entry that holds another place swaps the two.

unsaved.title: Leave the page with unsaved changes?
unsaved.body: You have changes on this page that are not saved yet. If you leave the page, they are lost.

notFound.title: Title not found
notFound.body: This title does not exist or no longer exists.

file.title: File
file.none: No file is available for this title right now.

recommend.hint: For every profile that may see the title, without your name
recommend.added_one: Added to the user picks. Stays {{count}} day.
recommend.added_other: Added to the user picks. Stays {{count}} days.

unsupported.title: Format cannot be played
unsupported.body: This browser cannot play this format.

error.body: The file could not be loaded.

tracks.isDefault: {{language}} is the default for this profile.
tracks.madeDefault: {{language}} is now the default for this profile.

watchLimit.body_one: This profile may watch {{count}} minute a day. See you tomorrow.
watchLimit.body_other: This profile may watch {{count}} minutes a day. See you tomorrow.

streamLimit.body_one: This profile may play {{count}} stream at a time. Stop another playback and try again.
streamLimit.body_other: This profile may play {{count}} streams at a time. Stop another playback and try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.nightModeHint: Quiet passages louder, loud ones quieter: for late evenings.

zones.action: Move between the timeline, the buttons and the tabs; ← → go from button to button, tab to tab and card to card

back.action: Closes a panel, the help and the stream info (in the gear: one level up), otherwise back to the detail page
back.actionOfflineDownloads: Closes a panel, the help and the tab (in the gear: one level up), otherwise back to the downloads
back.actionOfflineLibrary: Closes a panel, the help and the tab (in the gear: one level up), otherwise back to the offline library

radio.title: Radio
radio.intro: Station catalog, running relays and the settings of the web radio. Stations see the Slouchcat server, not the device, so the server's location counts. Slouchcat passes the sound only to signed-in profiles of this installation; whether that is allowed for a station is up to the operator of the installation.

memory.title: No RAM buffer
memory.body: No RAM buffer: radio plays live only, without time shift. The buffer needs the tmpfs of the compose file in the container.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.running: A sync is queued or running.

relays.title: Live relays
relays.noListeners: No listeners left, runs on for a moment.

stop.label: Stop {{profile}} listening
stop.title: Stop {{profile}} listening?
stop.body: Playback of {{station}} ends for this profile at once.

stations.caption: Stations
stations.exceptionsHelp: Changed by hand, hidden, recommended or broken. A search always covers every station.

settings.title: Settings
settings.bufferHelp: How far listeners can go back. 60 minutes halve the number of stations while the budget stays.
settings.newRelays: Applies to relays that start from now on.
settings.maxRelaysHelp_one: At the current time shift the budget allows {{count}} station.
settings.maxRelaysHelp_other: At the current time shift the budget allows {{count}} stations.
settings.graceHelp: How long a relay runs on after its last listener left.
settings.hideBrokenHelp: Stations that do not answer are left out of the app's lists. As favourites they stay.
settings.countriesHelp: Profiles see stations of these countries only. The sync still fetches all of them.
settings.rights: Stations see the Slouchcat server, not the device, so the server's location counts. Slouchcat passes the sound only to signed-in profiles of this installation; whether that is allowed for a station is up to the operator of the installation.
settings.coverMusicbrainzHelp: Looks up the cover of the playing title at MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive, only when the title of a running station changes and at most once a second.
settings.coverItunesHelp: Asks the iTunes search when MusicBrainz finds nothing; at most 20 requests a minute. A picture the station sends itself always counts.

editor.name: Name
editor.logoReset: Back to the logo from catalog or website
editor.logoTooLarge: The file is larger than 20 MB.
editor.regionHelp: ISO code, for example CH-ZH. Empty: no region.
editor.probeResult: {{codec}}, {{bitrate}} kbit/s, {{sampleRate}} Hz, {{channels}} channels, answer after {{ms}} ms
editor.hiddenHelp: Shows nowhere in the app and does not come back with the sync.
editor.lockHelp: The daily sync never overwrites a locked field.

rules.title: Tagging
rules.coverageHelp: Share of the reachable, shown stations with a value. A kind counts only when a tag, the name or the administration sets it.
rules.worklistHelp_one: By number of stations. Tags of fewer than {{count}} station are not listed. A rule applies at once to every station with the tag.
rules.worklistHelp_other: By number of stations. Tags of fewer than {{count}} stations are not listed. A rule applies at once to every station with the tag.
rules.worklistEmpty: Every common tag has a rule.
rules.rulesHelp: Tag → facet. An own rule replaces the default for its facet; what was set by hand on a station stays.
rules.removeBody: “{{tag}}” falls back to the default for this facet. The stations are sorted again at once.
rules.removeIgnoreBody: “{{tag}}” goes back on the list of tags without a rule.
rules.assignedDone: “{{tag}}” is now {{target}}. The stations are sorted again.
rules.changedDone: The rule for “{{tag}}” is saved. The stations are sorted again.

own.title: Own stations
own.help: Stations the catalog lacks, such as neighbourhood or stadium radios. The sync never changes them.
own.deleteBody: The station goes for every profile, also from “My stations”. Whoever listens to it now is cut off.
own.editorHelp: Own station: the stream address, homepage, country and languages can be changed here.

fields.name: Name
fields.streamUrlHelp: A direct address or a playlist (.pls, .m3u); the server resolves it. Addresses in the local network are not allowed.
fields.homepageHelp: Optional; the server fetches the logo from there.
fields.countryHelp: ISO code, for example CH. Empty: no country.
fields.languagesHelp: ISO codes, separated by commas, for example de, fr.

create.title: Add an own station
create.description: A station the catalog lacks. It can be filtered like any other.

discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.body: Your changes to the metadata are not saved yet. If you close the editor, they are lost.

editor.subtitle: {{kind}} · {{library}}
editor.notFound: This title does not exist (any more).

upload.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 20 MB. The server derives the sizes itself and never fetches an uploaded image again.

error.tooLarge: The file is larger than 20 MB.
error.format: This is no JPEG, PNG or WebP image, or the file is damaged.
error.pixels: The image has more than 50 megapixels.
error.missing: No file arrived. Please choose it again.
error.kind: This image kind cannot be uploaded for this title.

images.candidatesBook: Images in the folder and in the files
images.chooseHint: A click chooses the image: it applies at once and stays locked until you set it back to automatic.
images.stillsOff: Episode stills are switched off for this library. They can be switched on in the administration under Metadata.
images.noKinds: This title has no image kinds.

metadata.intro: What you change here locks the field: «Refresh» no longer overwrites it. The lock lifts the lock again.
metadata.lang: Texts apply to the language {{language}}; the server keeps fetching the other languages from the providers.
metadata.langBook: Texts apply to every language row of the book.

match.intro: Search and choose a hit: the server stores the match and loads the title again.
match.notMatchable: The server matches seasons and episodes through their series.

refresh.body: «Refresh now» reloads every free field and every automatically chosen image. Locked fields and chosen images stay.
refresh.unlockAll: Lift every lock of this title first
refresh.unlockAllHint: Afterwards what the providers deliver applies again. A manual match and an own rating stay.
refresh.hint: Runs as a job with high priority; the new values appear once it is done.

book.body: «Read the files again» reads metadata.json, the tags and the folder names once more. Locked fields and a chosen cover stay.
book.unlockAllHint: Lift every lock of this book first: afterwards what the files say applies again. An own rating stays.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.intro: Folders Slouchcat watches and the state of their scans.

keyframes.summary: Keyframe index: {{indexed}} of {{videoFiles}} video files · {{pending}} pending · {{unavailable}} not possible
keyframes.backfill: Backfill on the background jobs page

error.root_missing: The folder is missing. Is the drive mounted? Nothing was deleted.
error.root_empty: The folder is empty. Nothing was deleted.
error.loss_over_threshold: More than 20 % of the files are missing. Nothing was deleted to be safe.
error.cancelled: The scan was cancelled. The next scan runs normally again.

acceptLoss.title: Remove missing files?
acceptLoss.body: The next scan removes the missing titles from the library; progress for these titles is lost. Only do this when the files were deleted on purpose.

libraries.scanCancelled: The scan of {{name}} has been cancelled.
libraries.scanAborted: The scan of {{name}} has been stopped.
libraries.noRoots: No folder: the titles come from subscribed feeds.

changeRating.title: Default rating of {{name}}
changeRating.description: Every title whose rating comes from the library follows at once. Ratings set by hand stay.
changeRating.saved: The default rating of {{name}} is now {{rating}}.

folders.title: Folders of {{name}}
folders.description: A library can hold several folders. The scan and the watcher pick up a new one at once.
folders.none: This library has no folder. Nothing is scanned until you add one.

remove.label: Remove the folder {{path}}
remove.title: Really remove this folder?
remove.mismatch: Type {{path}} exactly, then the button becomes active.
remove.lead_one: You are removing <path>{{path}}</path> from the library {{name}}. Up to {{count}} title leaves every list with it. What that means:
remove.lead_other: You are removing <path>{{path}}</path> from the library {{name}}. Up to {{count}} titles leave every list with it. What that means:
remove.soft: The titles are soft-deleted: they vanish from every list, but progress, watchlist entries and picks stay attached to them. A title with a file in another folder of this library stays visible.
remove.downloads: Really gone are the offline downloads: devices that hold one of these titles delete the package at their next sync.
remove.playback: A playback running from this folder breaks off mid-stream.
remove.webhooks: The path map of Radarr and Sonarr points nowhere for this path afterwards; reports about it are refused.
remove.relink: If the titles come back later, even through another folder, Slouchcat finds them by their TMDB, TVDB or IMDb id and moves progress and lists back. If you only move the folder, use «Change path» instead of «Remove».
remove.oneWay: If the folder lies outside the browsable folders (SLOUCHCAT_BROWSE_ROOTS), it cannot be added again without a change to the configuration.
remove.last: It is the last folder: {{name}} stays, but holds no folder afterwards and scans nothing.

change.label: Change folder {{path}}
change.title: Change folder
change.identifier: The identifier changes: season and episode texts are assigned anew after {{provider}}. The episodes themselves stay, progress and watchlist stay attached to them.
change.fillers: Only the fillers change: the titles are filled in again, nothing is deleted.
change.content: The content changes: that works like removing the folder and adding it again. The titles of this folder are soft-deleted and created anew, offline packages are gone, progress and watchlist stay with the old titles.

move.label: Change the path of {{path}}
move.title: Change path?
move.body: Old path: {{old}} · New path: {{new}}. Titles and user data stay when the files lie there under the same names. The folder is read anew afterwards.
move.saved: The folder now lies at {{path}} and is read anew.

libraries.noFolder: No folder: nothing is scanned until you add one under “Folders”.

trickplay.title: Seek preview: {{name}}
trickplay.description: Small pictures above the timeline, one every 10 seconds. Films and series are set separately, also in a library that holds both.
trickplay.keepHint: There at once from the second start. Without keeping, the preview is deleted after playback.

ahead.movie: New films get their preview when they are imported; «Generate now» or the schedule on «Background jobs» catch up on the rest. If one is missing at a start, it takes 20 to 45 seconds and is kept.
ahead.episode: New episodes get their preview when they are imported; «Generate now» or the schedule on «Background jobs» catch up on the rest. If one is missing at a start, it takes 20 to 45 seconds and is kept.

facts.onStartKeep: At the first start the preview takes 20 to 45 seconds, the first sheet 5 to 10 seconds, and is kept. Titles nobody watches take no space.
facts.onStart: Every start makes the preview anew in 20 to 45 seconds; it is deleted 10 minutes after the end. Each start costs processing time and a few hundred MB from the NAS.

seriesStart.series: When an episode starts, its preview is made at once, then in the background those of every other episode of the series. Everything is kept.
seriesStart.season_rest: When an episode starts, its preview is made at once, then in the background those of the other episodes of the season (at the last episode those of the next season). Everything is kept.
seriesStart.next_episode: When an episode starts, its preview is made at once, then in the background that of the next episode. Everything is kept.

facts.off: No preview. The timeline shows the chapter name and image as before.

estimate.basis: Estimated storage from the running time of the titles, about 1.5 MB per hour of video.
estimate.unavailable: The storage estimate is not available right now.

drop.movies: After saving, the kept previews of the films are deleted ({{size}}). Running playbacks keep them until they end.
drop.series: After saving, the kept previews of the series are deleted ({{size}}). Running playbacks keep them until they end.
drop.both: After saving, the kept previews are deleted: films ({{movies}}) and series ({{series}}). Running playbacks keep them until they end.

generate.hint: Catches up on the missing previews of every library «In advance», like «Backfill seek previews» on «Background jobs».
generate.queued: Catching up on the previews is queued.

trickplay.saved: The seek preview of {{name}} is saved.

notAllowed.title: Administrators only
notAllowed.body: This area is managed by the primary profile of an administrator account.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.intro: Titles and files that need attention.

hint.unmatched: Without a match there is no description, artwork or rating. Match the title or refresh it.
hint.no_images: Matched titles without a poster. A refresh loads the artwork again.
hint.unrated: Titles without a rating are seen only by 18-rated profiles. Assign a rating to release them.
hint.orphaned: Titles without a file or with missing files, empty seasons and series.
hint.unplayable: Files that cannot be read. Check them again or remove them from the library.
hint.rating_mismatch: The stored rating differs from the computed one. A rating change or the next scan corrects it. There is nothing to select here.
hint.duplicates: Titles that exist twice. Pick the title to keep and merge the others into it.
hint.relink: Deleted titles that are back in the library as a new copy. Progress, history and lists still hang on the deleted title. «Relink» merges the copy into it; the old title stays.

maintenance.caption: {{kind}} in {{library}}

done.match: Match saved, the metadata is being loaded.
done.relinkStopped_one: {{count}} relinked. A scan is running. Start «Relink» again after the scan for the rest.
done.relinkStopped_other: {{count}} relinked. A scan is running. Start «Relink» again after the scan for the rest.
done.relinkSkipped_one: 1 skipped: the pair no longer exists, for example because it was already merged.
done.relinkSkipped_other: {{count}} skipped: the pair no longer exists, for example because it was already merged.

cleanup.title: Clean up titles?
cleanup.body_one: The selected title is removed from the library. Files on disk stay untouched.
cleanup.body_other: The {{count}} selected titles are removed from the library. Files on disk stay untouched.

remove.title: Remove files?
remove.body_one: The selected file is removed from the library and skipped by future scans. It stays on disk.
remove.body_other: The {{count}} selected files are removed from the library and skipped by future scans. They stay on disk.

reason.file_and_feed: File and feed of the same episode

duplicates.confirmBody_one: Files, extras, trailers and progress of the other title move to “{{title}}”. The other title is deleted.
duplicates.confirmBody_other: Files, extras, trailers and progress of the {{count}} other titles move to “{{title}}”. The other titles are deleted.

relink.confirmMerge_one: 1 copy merges into its deleted title. The old title comes back and keeps its address.
relink.confirmMerge_other: {{count}} copies merge into their deleted titles. The old titles come back and keep their addresses.
relink.confirmNoData_one: The deleted title has no user data.
relink.confirmNoData_other: The deleted titles have no user data.
relink.confirmRemoved_one: The copy is removed for good.
relink.confirmRemoved_other: The copies are removed for good.
relink.confirmExtra_one: One more copy of the same title is skipped and is then listed under «Duplicates».
relink.confirmExtra_other: {{count}} more copies of the same titles are skipped and are then listed under «Duplicates».

item.title: Manage title

notAllowed.title: Administrators only
notAllowed.body: Titles are managed by the primary profile of an administrator account.

item.notFound: This title does not exist or no longer exists.

language.title: Original language
language.label: Set original language
language.hint: A chosen language or «Unknown» is locked. «From metadata» lifts the lock, and the next match asks the sources again.
language.knownFailed: The list of languages could not be loaded.

trailers.title: Trailers
trailers.urlHint: youtube.com/watch?v=…, youtu.be/… or the video id.
trailers.langCodeHint: Two or three lower-case letters, for example fr.

delete.title: Delete trailer?
delete.body: The trailer is removed. An automatically found trailer may come back with the next refresh.

images.title: Images
images.intro: Per kind the chosen image with source and language. A choice of your own locks the kind; "Apply" and "Refresh" keep it.
images.empty: No candidates. Is the title matched and the source set up?
images.unavailable: Not reachable: {{providers}}. The list shows the other sources.
images.chosenSaved: {{kind}} chosen and locked; the image is being fetched.
images.unlocked: Lock of {{kind}} lifted; the automatic choice runs.

match.title: Match title
match.description: Search TMDB or TVDB for the title and pick the right entry.

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: Browsers and devices that signed in, with the capability profile of their last playback start.

hint.devices: Grouped by type. The capabilities are in the tab next to it.
hint.capabilities: Capability profile of the last playback start of each device.

devices.caption: {{view}}: {{type}}

forget.label: Forget {{name}}
forget.title: Forget the device “{{name}}”?
forget.body: Running streams end and the device's sessions are signed out. If it is the device you are using right now, you are signed out here at once.

streams.title: Streams
streams.intro: Everything that is playing now. The list refreshes every 5 seconds.
streams.listHelp: Newest first, radio in the same list.
streams.emptyKind: Nothing of this kind is playing.

partial.streams: Playbacks are missing from the list until the request succeeds again.
partial.radio: Radio listeners are missing from the list until the request succeeds again.

stop.label: Stop the stream of {{profile}}
stop.title: Stop the stream of {{profile}}?
stop.body: Playback of “{{title}}” stops on the device within seconds.

bandwidth.label: Total bandwidth
bandwidth.notePartial: Sum of the known bit rates

radio.stopBody: The playback of “{{station}}” stops on the device within seconds.

podcasts.title: Podcasts
podcasts.intro: Subscribed feeds and podcasts from folders. The background job “Check podcast feeds” fetches the subscriptions that are due and adds new episodes.
podcasts.emptyLibrary: No podcast in this library yet.
podcasts.noLibrary: Add a library of the kind Podcasts first.

detail.author: Author
detail.noFeedFolder: No feed, the episodes come from the folder.
detail.folderNote: A folder holds this podcast. It comes back with every scan; it can only be removed with the folder under Libraries.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to feed
subscribe.description: Slouchcat fetches the feed right away and adds the podcast with its episodes.
subscribe.urlHint: RSS feed of the podcast, for example https://example.org/feed.xml.

remove.label: Unsubscribe from {{title}}
remove.title: Unsubscribe from {{title}}?
remove.body: The podcast and its episodes disappear from the library. Downloads of the episodes are removed at the next sync.

picks.title: User picks
picks.intro: Profiles of the owner's account recommend titles with the star on the title page; every other account only sees the list. Names stay hidden, and every title is listed once.

retention.title: Expiry
retention.label: Picks stay
retention.help: 7 to 365 days, 60 by default. Every new pick of the same title starts the period again. A shorter period applies at once.

picks.empty: No profile recommends a title right now. Without a pick the start page shows no row «User picks».
picks.anonymous: The administration sees how many picks a title has, never which profile picked it.
picks.homeRowsHint: Where the row stands on the start page and whether it appears is set under <page>Start page</page>.

remove.label: Remove {{title}}
remove.title: Remove {{title}} from the user picks?
remove.body: Every pick of this title goes. The title stays in the library.

collections.title: Collections
collections.intro: Collections from TMDB appear by themselves when titles are matched and cannot be changed. Put together your own collections here.

remove.label: Delete collection {{name}}
remove.title: Delete collection {{name}}?
remove.body: The titles stay in the library; only the collection goes.

members.title: Members of {{name}}
members.empty: No titles in this collection yet.

search.label: Search titles
search.hint: Two characters or more: films, series, audiobooks and podcasts.

collections.lockedNote: This collection comes from TMDB: its members, name and deletion are locked.

homeRows.title: Start page
homeRows.intro: Order of the start page rows, for every profile. Hidden and empty rows do not appear.
homeRows.tooMany: Already {{count}} rows visible. Hide another one first.

rows.spotlight: The Trakt list, intersected with the library. Shown as a stage with a backdrop at its place; below the minimum number of matches it is left out.
rows.picks: Titles the profiles of the owner account recommend; newest first, with an expiry.
rows.recent: The titles that came into a library most recently.
rows.released: By release date within the last twelve months; a series by its newest episode.
rows.collections: Own collections and those from TMDB.
rows.genres: The genres of the visible titles.
rows.libraries: One tile per library the profile sees, with the number of titles; it opens the library page.
rows.library: The titles that came into this library most recently; “Show all” opens the library sorted by “Recently added”.
rows.radio: The favourite stations of the profile as tiles; a station playing through the server right now shows its current title. Without favourites the row is left out.

homeRows.moved: {{row}} is now at position {{position}}. Save to apply it.

discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.body: The unsaved order and hiding are lost; what is saved applies again.

preview.label: Preview of the start page
preview.note: A sketch with placeholders, in the unsaved order. On the real start page hidden rows are missing, and empty rows are left out too (an empty watchlist, for example).

homeRows.spotlight: Which Trakt list Spotlight shows, when it was last fetched and whether Trakt is set up is shown under “Spotlight”.

spotlight.title: Spotlight
spotlight.intro: A public Trakt list as a row of the start page. Only titles in your own library are shown; each profile sees only what its age rating allows.
spotlight.enabledHint: Takes effect with “Save”, together with the source.

source.title: Source
source.listUrlHint: A public list on trakt.tv, such as https://trakt.tv/users/name/lists/name-of-the-list. Watchlists are not possible.
source.mediaFilters: The list mixes films and series: the media filters its entries after the fetch.
source.itemCountHint: titles in the row, per profile (5–20)
source.minHitsHint: hits in the library, per profile (0–10)

missing.noKey: Without a Trakt key the row is missing from the start page.
missing.disabled: Spotlight is switched off: the row is missing from the start page.
missing.failed: The row is missing from the start page until a fetch succeeds.
missing.empty: The list is empty: the row is missing from the start page.
missing.belowMinHits: Only {{hits}} hits in the library, fewer than the required {{min}}: the row is missing from the start page. Profiles that see fewer titles may not get it even otherwise.

entries.title: Entries of the list
entries.intro: Order from Trakt; your own changes stay through the next fetch.
entries.empty: No entries yet. Fetch the list once Trakt is set up.
entries.notInLibrary: Not in the library, does not appear on the start page

pin.label: Pin {{title}}
pin.title: Pin {{title}}
pin.rankHint: 1 is the first place. The place holds for the whole list; a profile with fewer hits sees the title earlier.
pin.allTaken: All places are taken; unpin one first.

note.label: Note on {{title}}
note.title: Note on {{title}}
note.hint: At most {{max}} characters. Empty removes the note.

orphans.title: Orphaned overrides
orphans.intro: Overrides of titles that are no longer in the list. They take effect again only when the title returns.

spotlight.rowSettings: Where the row stands on the start page and whether it appears is set under “Start page”.

home.title: Administration
home.liveFailed: No answer, trying again every 5 seconds

update.title: Version {{version}} is available
update.body: You are running {{current}}. Slouchcat installs nothing itself: get the new image with docker compose pull and restart with docker compose up -d.

development.title: You are running a development build
development.body: {{current}} is not a published release, so there is no comparison and no update hint. Latest release: {{latest}}.
development.bodyUnknown: {{current}} is not a published release, so there is no comparison and no update hint.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.count_one: {{count}} report in the log of the last 24 hours, from {{total}} integrations.
webhooks.count_other: {{count}} reports in the log of the last 24 hours, from {{total}} integrations.

restart.title: Restart the server?
restart.streams_one: {{count}} running stream stops. Running downloads for on the go are interrupted.
restart.streams_other: {{count}} running streams stop. Running downloads for on the go are interrupted.
restart.idle: Nothing is playing right now. Running downloads for on the go are interrupted.
restart.waitBody: Slouchcat shuts down in order and starts again. As soon as the server answers, the page reloads.

install.title: Install the update to {{version}}?
install.body: The server restarts; running playbacks stop. Before a database change it backs up the database.

phase.backing_up: The updater backs up .env and enters the new version.
phase.pulling: The updater downloads the new image.
phase.verifying: The updater checks the fingerprint of the image.
phase.restarting: The server restarts with the new version.
phase.waiting: The updater waits until the new server is healthy (at most 10 minutes).

install.down: The server does not answer right now. Waiting for it …

silent.title: The server has not answered for more than 70 minutes
silent.body: No update takes that long. On the host, check with docker compose ps and docker compose logs whether the server and the updater companion run.

install.rolledBack: Update to {{to}} failed, version {{from}} runs again.
install.rolledBackNoVersion: Update failed, the previous version runs again.
install.migrated: The migration ran; going back only with the backup {{backup}}.
install.migratedNoBackup: The migration ran; going back only with the backup made before it.

failure.disk_full: The server has no space for the new image. Free some space and try again.
failure.deploy_files: The Compose files of the release could not be fetched or written; the update was aborted.

refused.title: The updater did not start the update
refused.not_newer: The newest version is not newer than the running one.
refused.no_digest: The release manifest names no fingerprint (digest) of the image.
refused.no_compose_labels: The server was not started with Docker Compose, so the updater does not know how to restart it. Install the update by hand.
refused.outside_deploy_dir: A Compose file of the server lies outside SLOUCHCAT_DEPLOY_DIR.
refused.manifest_unreachable: The release manifest cannot be reached. Try again later.
refused.other: The updater refused for a reason this app does not know.

manual.unavailable: The updater companion does not answer. Install the update by hand.
manual.intro: Without the updater companion you install the update on the host, in the folder with compose.yaml and .env:
manual.introByHand: By hand you install the update on the host, in the folder with compose.yaml and .env:
manual.files: Use the same -f files as at the start (for example docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.intel.yaml pull), or they are missing after the update.
manual.docs: Guide: update at the press of a button with the updater companion

outdated.title: The updater is outdated; from version 1.18.0 it updates itself. Lift it by hand once:
outdated.files: If you list the Compose files with -f instead of COMPOSE_FILE, append the same -f list.

hints.title: Notices
hints.scanOther: The loss protection aborted the scan.

errors.title: Server log
errors.intro: The last 50 errors of the server log, newest first.

browse.title: Folder browser blocked
browse.hanging: A mount stopped answering: {{count}} listing hangs in the kernel and cannot be cancelled. The folder browser still works, with fewer slots. A restart frees them.
browse.hanging_other: A mount stopped answering: {{count}} listings hang in the kernel and cannot be cancelled. The folder browser still works, with fewer slots. A restart frees them.
browse.off: Every slot of the folder browser hangs on a mount that stopped answering. No folder can be browsed until the server restarts; typing a path by hand still works.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.intro: Provider keys, delivery of notifications and the update check. Slouchcat stores secret values encrypted and never shows them again.
integrations.envHint: Set in deploy/.env. The value can only be changed there.

clear.label: Delete {{name}}
clear.title: Delete {{name}}?
clear.body: The stored value is removed. Whatever needs it stops working.

keys.title: Provider keys
keys.intro: For metadata (TMDB, TVDB), images (Fanart.tv), trailers (YouTube) and the Trakt lists of the home page.
keys.newValue: Leave empty to keep the stored value. A new value replaces it.

tmdb.name: TMDB token
tmdb.description: API read access token from themoviedb.org: overviews, posters and age ratings.

tvdb.name: TVDB key
tvdb.description: API key from thetvdb.com: optional second source for series.

tvdbPin.name: TVDB PIN
tvdbPin.description: Subscriber PIN, only for a TVDB subscription with a PIN.
tvdbPin.link: Look up the PIN at thetvdb.com

youtube.name: YouTube key
youtube.description: YouTube Data API key: finds trailers when TMDB knows none.
youtube.link: Get a key in the Google Cloud Console

trakt.name: Trakt client ID
trakt.description: For the rows “Trending” and “Popular” of the home page.
trakt.link: Get a client ID at trakt.tv

fanart.name: Fanart.tv key
fanart.description: Project key (API key) from fanart.tv: logos and high-quality posters as the last image source; switch it on under "Metadata". New images show after 7 days.
fanart.link: Get a project key at fanart.tv

fanartClient.name: Fanart.tv personal key
fanartClient.description: Optional: new images after 2 days instead of 7.
fanartClient.link: Get a personal key at fanart.tv

webhooks.title: Webhooks from Radarr and Sonarr
webhooks.intro: Radarr and Sonarr report changed files here, so new titles appear at once. Slouchcat never calls those services itself.
webhooks.caption: Webhook integrations

form.title: New integration
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Your choice; it only tells the entries of this list apart.

created.title: Address for “{{name}}”
created.once: Copy it now — the address is not shown again.
created.label: Full address
created.copyFailed: Copying failed; the address is selected, press Ctrl+C.

pathMap.intro: Translates the path Radarr or Sonarr reports. Needed as soon as the same storage is mounted differently on each side — say “/mnt/medien/Filme” in the service and “/media/Filme” here. The longest matching start wins; without an entry the reported path is used as it is. Both paths must be absolute and start with “/”.
pathMap.elsewhere: Someone else has changed the path mapping of this integration in the meantime. Your rows are still here and will be stored when you save.

renew.label: Renew the token of {{name}}
renew.title: Renew the token of “{{name}}”?
renew.body: The current address stops working at once. The new one is shown once and has to be entered in Radarr or Sonarr again.

delete.label: Delete {{name}}
delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.body: The address stops working at once, and the report log goes with it.

email.title: E-mail server
email.intro: For notifications, invitations and announcements by e-mail.
email.name: E-mail server
email.userHint: Sign-in name at the e-mail server, if needed.
email.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
email.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
email.tlsHint: STARTTLS for port 587, TLS for port 465.
email.testFailed: The test mail did not arrive: {{detail}}

telegram.title: Telegram bot
telegram.name: Telegram bot
telegram.botHelp: Slouchcat finds it through the token.
telegram.tokenHelp: For notifications by Telegram. The token comes from @BotFather; Slouchcat checks it with Telegram.
telegram.tokenReplace: A new token replaces the stored one.

push.title: Web Push
push.intro: Notifications in the browser and in the installed app.
push.notConfigured: No key pair yet. It is created as soon as a device turns on Web Push.

rotate.title: Create new Web Push keys?
rotate.body: Every device loses its subscription and has to turn on Web Push again in the settings.

push.rotated: New keys created. The devices have to turn on Web Push again.

update.title: Update check
update.intro: Once a day Slouchcat reads the public release manifest and shows a hint when there is a new version. Nothing is installed.

publicUrl.title: Public address
publicUrl.intro: Links in e-mails and messages lead to the server at this address.
publicUrl.name: Public address
publicUrl.label: Address

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.intro: Every account with its role, rating level, libraries, profiles and the channels it receives notifications on. A new account starts with an invitation. You manage the profiles of your own account here; every other account manages its own profiles.

edit.title: Change account
edit.intro: E-mail address and password of your account. Every change needs your current password.
edit.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the password. Otherwise at least 10 characters.
edit.unchanged: Change the e-mail address or enter a new password.

access.title: Access of {{email}}
access.limitsHint: Applies to every profile of this account.
access.heading: Access
access.adminHint: An administrator always has rating 18 and all libraries; «Access» exists only for accounts without administration.

promote.title: Make {{email}} an administrator?
promote.body: The account will manage the server, the libraries and the settings. Its rating rises to 18 and all libraries; the account's profiles keep their own levels.

demote.title: Take the administrator role away from {{email}}?
demote.body: The account will manage only its own profiles and is signed out everywhere. Rating and libraries stay where they are; set them again on purpose.
demote.done: {{email}} is an account without administration now.

remove.title: Remove the account {{email}}?
remove.body: The account, its profiles and its progress are deleted. Running sessions and playback end at once. Downloads on the account's devices disappear the next time they reach the server. A device that never comes online again keeps them.

invitations.intro: A link works once and for seven days. Whoever opens it creates their own account.
invitations.noteHint: A name, for example. The invited person sees the note too.

created.once: Copy the link now: it is shown only this once.
created.label: Invitation link
created.copyFailed: Copying is not possible. The link is selected, copy it with Ctrl+C.

profiles.readOnly: Every account manages its own profiles.

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: Back up and restore the database and the settings. Media are never part of a backup.
backup.caption: Backups: {{kind}}

groups.autoHint: The server makes automatic backups before a migration of the database (with an update) and before a restore.

create.intro: The backup holds the database with accounts, profiles, progress and settings. Media are never part of it.
create.withoutHint: Credentials such as the TMDB and Trakt keys, the e-mail server, the Telegram bot and the web push keys stay out. After a restore you enter them again. Addresses of private podcast feeds stay in, with their access code, so the subscriptions carry on afterwards.
create.withHint: The backup also holds the key to the credentials. That is why the whole archive is encrypted with a passphrase (at least {{min}} characters). Without the passphrase it cannot be restored.
create.passphraseHint: At least {{min}} characters. Keep it apart from the backup.

delete.title: Delete the backup “{{name}}”?
delete.body: The file is deleted from the server's backup folder. Downloaded copies stay.

restore.warning: Restoring replaces all data of this server with the state of the backup. The server restarts afterwards, and everyone is signed out.
restore.fileHint: A file slouchcat-backup-….tar.gz or, with keys, ….tar.gz.age.
restore.confirmBodyNamed: Accounts, profiles, progress and settings are replaced by the state of “{{name}}”. The server restarts afterwards, and everyone is signed out.

restart.title: The server is restarting
restart.body: The backup (version {{version}}) is checked and goes in at the start. As soon as the server answers again, the sign-in opens.
restart.noSecrets: The backup holds no credentials: enter the keys, the e-mail server and the Telegram bot again under integrations afterwards.

restart.silent: No new server has answered for {{seconds}} seconds.

slow.title: The server does not come back
slow.body: The restart takes unusually long. Look at the container's log (docker logs slouchcat) and reload this page once the server runs.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: What was watched lately, across every account and profile.

top.title: Most watched
top.empty: Nothing was watched in this period.

profiles.title: Watch time per profile
profiles.chart: Watch time per profile as a chart
profiles.label: {{profile}} ({{email}})
profiles.empty: No profile watched anything in this period.

devices.title: Devices
devices.chart: Watch time per device type as a chart
devices.empty: No device played anything in this period.

when.title: When people watch
when.empty: Nothing was watched in these weeks.
when.zone: Hours in the server's time zone ({{zone}}).
when.gridChart: Watch time by day of the week and hour

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.intro: News for everyone: every profile sees a published announcement at its next start, and the accounts receive it on their channels.

form.title: New announcement
form.bodyHint: At most {{max}} characters. Line breaks are kept.

preview.title: How profiles see it
preview.noBody: The text appears here, the way profiles see it.

discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.body: The unsaved changes to “{{title}}” are lost.
discard.newBody: The new announcement is not saved yet. Its title and text are lost.

publish.label: Publish “{{title}}”
publish.title: Publish “{{title}}”?
publish.body: Every profile sees the announcement at its next start. It goes to the channels of every account that chose announcements; guests receive it by e-mail by default. It cannot be changed afterwards.
publish.reach: Every profile sees it at its next start, and it goes to the channels of every account that chose announcements. Guests receive it by e-mail by default.
publish.later: When it is published: {{reach}} It cannot be changed afterwards.

delete.label: Delete “{{title}}”
delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.body: The announcement and its read receipts are deleted. Messages already sent stay with the recipients.

jobs.title: Background jobs
jobs.intro: What the server does in the background: which jobs run, since when, for how much longer, and when the next run comes. Every job can be run now, paused and its runs cancelled.

pausedBanner.body: Paused jobs start no runs until you resume them: {{types}}.

running.title: Running now
running.pauseLabel: Pause {{name}} (stops this and every running run of the job)

card.triggerEvent: automatically, by events in the server
card.unknown: This server no longer knows this job (older build).

confirm.cancelQueuedBody_one: {{count}} queued run is cancelled and not made up for.
confirm.cancelQueuedBody_other: {{count}} queued runs are cancelled and not made up for.
confirm.cancelAllBody: {{queued}} queued and {{running}} running runs end at once. Cancelling is final.
confirm.cancelRunBody: The run ends at once and is not made up for.
confirm.notifyWarning: A cancelled delivery does not arrive.
confirm.scanWarning: The library ends as “aborted”; the next scan catches up.
confirm.downloadWarning: The downloads end as “failed” and are not prepared again.
confirm.cancelFailedBody: Slouchcat no longer retries this run.

messages.paused: {{name}} paused; running runs stop and go back to the queue.

schedule.title: Schedule of {{name}}
schedule.description: Interval, time window and on/off. The next run realigns; “Run now” ignores the window.
schedule.windowHint: Server time zone: {{zone}}. A window may span midnight.
schedule.traktHint: Interval and on/off are the same setting as on the spotlight page.
schedule.updateHint: On/off is the same setting as the update check in the settings.
schedule.heading: Schedule
schedule.eventNote: No schedule: runs by itself as soon as there is work for it, as described under “Triggered by”.
schedule.onceHint: Server time zone: {{zone}}. The date runs once besides the interval, also outside the time window.
schedule.onceRange: The date must lie between now and one year from now.
schedule.windowWaits: Outside the window, new runs wait; a running one finishes. Playback and downloads still start at once.

radio_catalog_sync.name: Sync radio catalog
radio_catalog_sync.description: Fetches the station catalog from Radio Browser, merges the entries into stations and sorts them into the filters.
radio_catalog_sync.trigger: daily from 04:30, «Sync now» on the Radio page, at the first start without a catalog

radio_logo_fetch.name: Fetch station logo
radio_logo_fetch.description: Fetches a station's logo from the catalog or its website and stores it square.
radio_logo_fetch.trigger: a station without logo in a list of the app, a reset logo

scan_library.name: Library scan
scan_library.description: Looks for new, changed and missing files in every library.
scan_library.trigger: Schedule every 6 h and server start, “Scan” on the libraries page, webhook, file watcher

scan_path.name: Folder scan
scan_path.description: Reads a single folder again as soon as something changes there.

probe_file.name: Probe file
probe_file.description: Reads tracks, length and format of a new or changed file.
probe_file.trigger: From the scan per new file, “Probe file” in maintenance

probe_keyframes.name: Keyframe index (read the whole file)
probe_keyframes.description: Reads a whole file when it lacks the index for seeking.
probe_keyframes.trigger: On import only without an index from the container, from the backfill, before a playback (also while paused) and for offline downloads

keyframes_backfill.name: Backfill keyframe index
keyframes_backfill.description: Queues every file without a keyframe index.
keyframes_backfill.trigger: Schedule (off by default, weekly) or a one-off date, “Run now”: reads the index from the container of every video file that has none yet

library_sweep.name: Sweep missing titles
library_sweep.description: Removes titles whose files have been missing beyond the grace period.

segments_detect.name: Detect intro and outro
segments_detect.description: Finds intro and outro of episodes for “Skip intro”.

chapters_images.name: Create chapter images
chapters_images.description: Creates the preview images of a file's chapters.
chapters_images.trigger: Per file 10 minutes after a playback ended, for new files after a complete scan and after a new probe

chapters_images_backfill.name: Backfill chapter images
chapters_images_backfill.description: Queues every file without chapter images for creation.
chapters_images_backfill.trigger: Schedule (off by default, weekly) or a one-off date, “Run now”: for every film and episode without chapter images

trickplay_generate.name: Create seek previews
trickplay_generate.description: Creates the preview images of the seek bar of a file, sheet by sheet.
trickplay_generate.trigger: when a film or an episode starts, for new files with “In advance”, by the backfill, by the series look-ahead and for offline downloads

trickplay_series.name: Previews of the other episodes
trickplay_series.description: Queues the previews of the other episodes of a series, the next two first.
trickplay_series.trigger: when an episode starts and the library is set to “At start, all episodes”

trickplay_backfill.name: Backfill seek previews
trickplay_backfill.description: Queues every film and episode without a complete preview for creation.
trickplay_backfill.trigger: Schedule (off by default, weekly) or a one-off date, “Run now”: for libraries set to “In advance”

library_relink.name: Relink deleted title
library_relink.description: Attaches a moved file to its old title and watched state.
library_relink.trigger: After the match of a title with a deleted twin

metadata_match.name: Match title
metadata_match.description: Finds the matching TMDB or TVDB entry for a new title.
metadata_match.trigger: From the scan, manual match, folder change

metadata_fill.name: Fill metadata
metadata_fill.description: Fetches texts, genres, rating, cast and images of a title.
metadata_fill.trigger: After the match, list change of a folder

metadata_vote_backfill.name: Backfill votes
metadata_vote_backfill.description: Fetches missing vote counts for choosing the images.
metadata_vote_backfill.trigger: After every full scan while titles wait for a vote

metadata_original_language_backfill.name: Backfill original languages
metadata_original_language_backfill.description: Adds the original language to every title for the audio choice.
metadata_original_language_backfill.trigger: Once at the first start after the update, then the schedule (off by default, weekly), a one-off date or “Run now”

image_fetch.name: Fetch images
image_fetch.description: Downloads the chosen images of a title and renders their sizes.
image_fetch.trigger: After the match, catch-up at start

people_images.name: Fetch person and collection images
people_images.description: Downloads the portraits of people and the posters of TMDB collections and renders their sizes.
people_images.trigger: After the match of a title with cast or a collection, and after a full scan, which fetches the backlog

people_images_backfill.name: Backfill person and collection images
people_images_backfill.description: Tries every person and collection again for which TMDB had no image.
people_images_backfill.trigger: Schedule (off by default, weekly) or a one-off date, “Run now”: forgets the failures and queues the run

metadata_apply.name: Apply metadata
metadata_apply.description: Applies changed metadata settings to a library.

trailer_find.name: Find trailer
trailer_find.description: Looks for a trailer on TMDB, YouTube or through the AI search.

podcast_fetch.name: Fetch podcast feed
podcast_fetch.description: Reads a single podcast feed and its new episodes.
podcast_fetch.trigger: From the feed poll per due subscription, “Refresh” per podcast, new subscription

podcast_poll.name: Check podcast feeds
podcast_poll.description: Checks every podcast feed for new episodes.
podcast_poll.trigger: Schedule every 5 min: due subscriptions are fetched

trakt_refresh.name: Fetch spotlight list
trakt_refresh.description: Fetches the Trakt list the spotlight takes its titles from.
trakt_refresh.trigger: Schedule at the interval of the spotlight page, “Fetch now”

update_check.name: Update check
update_check.description: Checks whether a newer Slouchcat version exists.
update_check.trigger: Schedule daily, 60 s after start, “Check now”

download_prepare.name: Prepare download
download_prepare.description: Prepares a download for offline playback.
download_prepare.trigger: A profile's download; the reconciliation every 10 min re-queues unfinished ones

notify_deliver.name: Deliver notification
notify_deliver.description: Sends a notification by e-mail, Telegram or Web Push.
notify_deliver.trigger: Every event with a channel (e-mail, Web Push, Telegram)

jobs_prune.name: Prune history
jobs_prune.description: Deletes old runs and failures from the history.
jobs_prune.trigger: Schedule daily: finished runs older than 30 days

failed.title: Latest failures (all types)
failed.shown: {{shown}} of {{total}} · All failures of a job type are under «Runs» in its row.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.intro: Which languages the metadata sources deliver, which images in which language and quality, and which country decides the age rating first. The default applies to every library; a library may deviate for languages and images.

links.roots: The order of the sources is set per folder under Libraries.
links.jobs: The schedules are under Background jobs.

scope.label: Applies to
scope.serverHint: Applies to every library without a deviation of its own.
scope.libraryHint: {{name}} uses the default. Switch «deviates» on to change languages or images for this library only.
scope.serverDirty: The default has unsaved changes; this shows what is saved.

languages.title: Languages
languages.intro: Every language here is fetched for every title; profiles pick the language of their descriptions from it. The interface stays German or English. Every further language costs one request per title and season.
languages.fallback: Order = fallback: when a text is missing in the profile's language, Slouchcat shows the first one of the list, then the file name. The default needs German; a library needs German or English.
languages.youtube: {{count}} languages: up to {{titles}} titles a day with the YouTube trailer search (quota 10,000).

images.title: Images
images.intro: Which image kinds are fetched and in which language. An image file next to the film (poster.jpg, fanart.jpg, logo.png) wins when it is wide enough; then the folder's sources, Fanart.tv last.

kindHint.logo: Title logo on the detail page and the spotlight instead of the text title
kindHint.episode_still: A still per episode; about 12 GB of cache for 40,000 episodes

images.notBuilt: Art, banner and disc are left out on purpose: no page shows them.
images.chainsIntro: The order an image is chosen in. «No text» is an image without lettering. Within a language the best-voted image wins.

quality.title: Image quality
quality.intro: Applies to every library. The delivered sizes (poster 200/400/800, backdrop 780/1280/1920, logo 400/800) are fixed.
quality.byVoteHint: The best-voted image of the language instead of the first hit.
quality.fallback: Without an image of the minimum width Slouchcat takes the best smaller one; a kind never stays empty only because the bar is too high.

sources.title: Sources
sources.intro: The order of the metadata sources is set per folder under Libraries; keys under Integrations. Here only what a source can do differently.
sources.tmdbAdult: TMDB: adult content in the search
sources.tmdbAdultHint: Otherwise it never appears in the match.
sources.localHint: poster.jpg, fanart.jpg, logo.png, seasonNN-poster.jpg next to the title; before every provider when wide enough.
sources.localSmall: Files too small or switched off stay candidates in the image choice per title.
sources.fanartHint: Logos and posters in high quality, after the folder's sources. Needs a key under Integrations; without a key it is never asked.

rating.title: Age rating
rating.intro: Which country is read first; then DE, AT, CH, GB, US as before. The steps stay FSK 0/6/12/16/18.
rating.hint: A new title gets the step of the country read first. A stored step is never lowered, not even by another country; lowering is done per title in maintenance.

apply.title: Apply to existing titles
apply.intro: New titles use the settings at once. Existing titles stay until you start the run; it appears under Background jobs with progress, pause and cancel.
apply.queued: Run {{id}} queued: {{count}} titles. Progress under Background jobs.

save.savedScope_one: Saved for {{name}}. {{count}} title affected – apply now?
save.savedScope_other: Saved for {{name}}. {{count}} titles affected – apply now?

discard.title: Discard the changes?
discard.body: The unsaved changes to {{names}} are lost.

errors.ui_lang_required: The default needs German; a library German or English.
errors.source_unknown: This image source is not a candidate of the title.

activity.scanAborted: Scan of “{{library}}” aborted by the loss protection

libraries.loadFailed: The libraries could not be loaded.

picker.title: Who's watching?
picker.loadFailed: The profiles could not be loaded.

pin.title: PIN for {{name}}
pin.intro: This profile is protected by a PIN.
pin.label: PIN
pin.invalid: The PIN is wrong. Try again.
pin.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in

settings.title: Profiles
settings.intro: Everyone in the household gets a profile of their own with age rating, language, colour and libraries.

onlyPrimary.title: Primary profile only
onlyPrimary.body: You manage profiles in the primary profile of this account. Switch to it to add or change profiles.

delete.title: Delete profile "{{name}}"?
delete.body: Progress and settings of this profile are lost. This cannot be undone.

pin.title: PIN for {{name}}
pin.label: New PIN
pin.hint: 4 to 8 digits. Without the PIN the profile cannot be opened.

remove.title: Remove the PIN of {{name}}?
remove.body: Afterwards anyone can open this profile without a PIN.

form.name: Name
form.ratingHint: Titles with a higher rating stay invisible to this profile.
form.metadataLanguageHint: Titles, descriptions and genres; the interface follows the language above.

report.title: Watch time of {{name}}
report.intro: Minutes per day over the last 30 days.

invite.title: Invitation to Slouchcat
invite.intro: Create your account and you can start right away.

form.profileNameHint: What your profile is called, for example your first name.

gone.title: Link no longer valid
gone.body: This link was already used, has expired or was withdrawn. Ask whoever invited you for a new link.

notFound.title: Link not found
notFound.body: This invitation link does not exist. Check that you copied all of it.

trailer.title: Trailer: {{title}}
trailer.privacy: The trailer is played by YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com).

notFound.title: Person not found
notFound.body: There are no titles for this person here.

state.network: Download interrupted, it tries again soon
state.range: The server does not send the file in parts (check the proxy)
state.budgetFull: Waiting for room on the server
state.paused: Paused, the server is streaming right now

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.intro: Titles {{name}} saved on this device. They play without a network too.

unsupported.title: Downloads are not possible here
unsupported.body: This browser cannot save titles. Downloads need a secure connection (HTTPS) and a current browser.

downloads.empty: No downloads on this device yet. Download films, episodes and whole seasons on their detail page.

delete.label: Delete {{title}}
delete.title: Delete the download {{title}}?
delete.body: The file is removed from this device. You can download the title again later.

downloads.offline: No connection to the server. Saved titles still play; changes reach the server at the next contact.

pinHint.title: PIN for offline use
pinHint.body: So that {{name}} opens offline on this device too, enter the profile's PIN here once.

storage.title: Storage
storage.unknown: Downloads: {{size}}. This browser does not tell the available storage.
storage.persisted: The browser keeps the downloads for good.
storage.notPersisted: The browser may delete the downloads when storage runs low.

apple.title: Note for iPhone, iPad and Safari
apple.body: Safari deletes the data of a web app that was not opened for a while. Open Slouchcat regularly to keep the downloads; as an app on the home screen they are better protected.

rules.title: Automatic downloads
rules.intro: Downloads the next episode of every series {{name}} watched in the last 60 days to this device, and new episodes of the podcasts {{name}} marked as favourites.
rules.wifiIos: iPhone and iPad do not tell the browser whether they are on Wi-Fi. Automatic downloads load there while the app is open.
rules.maxCount: At most this many unwatched episodes
rules.saved: Saved. The rule applies from the next sync.

dialog.title: Download {{title}}
dialog.intro: The title is saved on this device and plays without a network too.
dialog.seasonIntro_one: The only episode of this season is saved on this device.
dialog.seasonIntro_other: All {{count}} episodes of this season are saved on this device.
dialog.started_one: Download started. Its state is under Downloads.
dialog.started_other: {{count}} downloads started. Their state is under Downloads.

library.title: Offline library
library.intro: Who is watching? These profiles have downloads on this device.

empty.title: No downloads on this device
empty.body: Without a connection to the server only downloaded titles play.
empty.hint: Once you download titles online, you find them here without a network too.

locked.title: Downloads locked
locked.body: The account of this device signed out. The downloads stay stored and open again as soon as the same account signs in.

library.noneReady: No title is completely on this device yet.

pin.introOffline: This profile has its own offline PIN.
pin.offlineFormat: The offline PIN has 6 to 12 digits.

unavailable.title: Locked offline
unavailable.body: Enter this profile's PIN online on this device once, then it opens offline too.

player.failed: The saved file cannot be played.

missing.title: Download not available
missing.body: This download is not (or no longer) on this device, is not complete yet or is not released for this profile.

search.title: Search
search.label: Search term
search.start: Search for titles, people and collections, or pick a filter.

empty.title: Nothing found
empty.body: Try another term or fewer filters.

empty.title: Your watchlist is empty
empty.body: Keep titles for later with “Add to watchlist” on their detail page.

notFound.title: Collection not found
notFound.body: This collection does not exist or holds no title for this profile.

empty.title: No notifications
empty.body: Mark series or podcasts as favourites to hear about new episodes here.

playback.title: My playback
playback.intro: Sound and subtitles for the profile {{name}}, on every device. What you pick by hand in the player comes first.

audio.hint: A title plays in the first language of this list it has. If it has none of them, the original language plays.
audio.none: No audio language at the moment: the original language plays.

subtitleMode.label: Subtitles
subtitleMode.offHint: No subtitles until you switch them on in the player.
subtitleMode.forcedHint: Only the parts in another language, such as signs or foreign lines, in the language of the sound.
subtitleMode.foreignHint: Like «Forced only». When the sound is in none of your audio languages, full subtitles in the first subtitle language.
subtitleMode.alwaysHint: Always full subtitles in the first subtitle language; without them like «Forced only».

subtitles.hint: For full subtitles, the first one available first.
subtitles.none: No subtitle language at the moment: only forced subtitles show.

playback.limit: At most {{count}} languages; remove one to take another.

series.title: Series memory
series.body: When you pick the sound or subtitles of an episode by hand, Slouchcat remembers the language for the whole series.
series.confirmBody: Every series then plays by your languages and subtitles above again. This cannot be undone.

notifications.title: Notification channels
notifications.intro: New episodes of your favourites, invitations and announcements arrive here in addition to the app’s inbox. The settings apply to the whole account with all its profiles; a message about a profile starts with its name.
notifications.serverChannels: Set up the server’s channels → Integrations

onlyPrimary.title: Primary profile only
onlyPrimary.body: The channels apply to the whole account; they are changed in the primary profile. Switch to it to turn channels on or off.

events.label: Events
events.help: What a message is sent for.
events.helpAdmin: What a message is sent for. “Errors” is for administrators only.

unavailable.body: The main user sets up this channel in the administration under Integrations.

email.description: By default the address of your account.

telegram.instructionNoBot: Send the Slouchcat bot the message /start {{code}}
telegram.noBot: The bot’s name is missing: the main user has to enter the bot token under Integrations first.
telegram.label: Link
telegram.help: Connects the account with your chat with the bot.
telegram.waiting_one: Waiting for the message, checking every second.
telegram.waiting_other: Waiting for the message, checking every {{count}} seconds.
telegram.paused: Checking pauses while there are unsaved changes or a question is open.

unlinkConfirm.title: Unlink Telegram?
unlinkConfirm.body: Telegram messages no longer go to the linked chat. You can link again at any time with a new code.

discardConfirm.title: Discard the code?
discardConfirm.body: The open code stops working at once. You can link again at any time with a new code.

push.subscribed: This device now receives push messages.
push.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push messages here. It takes a current browser and a connection over HTTPS.
push.ios: On iPhone and iPad, Web Push works only in the installed app: choose “Add to Home Screen” in the share menu and open Slouchcat from there.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for Slouchcat. Allow them in the browser’s settings.
push.noWorker: The service worker is not running yet. Reload the page and try again.
push.failed: The browser could not register with its push service.

notifications.enabledHelp: Applies to the whole account with all its profiles.

page.title: User picks
page.intro: Titles the profiles of this household recommend, newest pick first.

page.title: Radio
page.intro: Stations from all over the world, through your Slouchcat server

rows.noFavorites: No stations saved yet. Tap the heart of a station and it shows here, for your profile only.

empty.title: No stations found
empty.body: No station matches these filters. Remove a filter or reset them all.

loading.title: The station catalog is loading
loading.body: Slouchcat is fetching the stations for the first time. The page tries again in a moment.

page.missing: No longer in the catalog, removed on {{date}}

player.serverHint: Through Slouchcat, from the server's location

shift.label: Time shift, up to {{minutes}} minutes back

player.longPause: The pause was longer than {{minutes}} minutes. Playing on from the oldest point.

played.heading: Previously played
played.empty: The station announced no titles before this one yet.

player.failed: This station cannot be played in this browser.

hint.title: Admins only
hint.spellings: The files name this series in several ways: {{names}}. Slouchcat shows it as one series.
hint.duplicates: These numbers appear more than once: {{volumes}}. The books differ by narrator; change a wrong number on the book.

notFound.title: Series not found
notFound.body: This series does not exist, or it has fewer than two books for this profile.

dialog.title: Edit series
dialog.name: Series name
dialog.nameHint: Changes the displayed name and locks it; the books stay as they are.
dialog.writeToVolumesHint: Sets the name as the series of every book and locks it. Series with the same name and the same author become one.
